92	Legend / boundaries:
93	- **PWA → Contentful, Vimeo, Didomi, GTM (via Addingwell), Optimizely Web, Crazy Egg, Narvar Promise (formerly CONVERT), Adyen Drop-In:** browser-direct from the PWA. No SFCC involvement. GTM, Optimizely, and Crazy Egg load post-Didomi-consent only. The GTM container is served from an Addingwell-managed first-party subdomain (Addingwell is owned by Didomi); tags deployed *inside GTM* are proxied through Addingwell. **Inside Chat** is loaded by GTM (script injection through the Addingwell container, post-consent — HPC-039/040), not a direct PWA include. **Optimizely Web** and **Crazy Egg** are injected by the PWA (Optimizely: US-only, single snippet all environments, pre-render anti-flicker). Narvar Promise is domestic storefronts only — international EDD is provided by Global-e. Adyen Drop-In tokenises card data in the browser; the Adyen server API (`/payments`, notifications, refunds) runs in the SFCC cartridge. **Vimeo** hosts product video, embedded as a lazy iframe (facade-loaded to protect LCP); editorial-page video is Contentful by default but may also embed Vimeo (HPC-004).
94	- **PWA → Google Maps, GiveX balance check, MuleSoft (select direct calls), Booxi:** called from the PWA's MRT Node layer via `/mobify/proxy/` — API credentials held as MRT environment variables; never reach the browser bundle. GiveX balance check is not a direct GiveX call — GiveX is reachable only over a persistent TCP socket, so MRT proxies an HTTPS request to MuleSoft, which owns the GiveX connection and credentials. Boutique appointment history (CRM-165–167) is read by a PWA-direct call from the MRT Node layer straight to Booxi — SFCC and MuleSoft are not in this path. Booxi credentials held as MRT environment variables.
95	- **PWA → SFCC:** all commerce data (catalogue, cart, pricing, customer, orders) via `@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react`.
96	- **SFCC → MuleSoft → NewStore / AP21 / Omneo / Narvar:** write and sync flows (order creation, fulfilment, CRM sync, EDD) — initiated by SFCC.
97	- **AP21 → MuleSoft → SFCC (inbound):** product and pricing master feed populates the SFCC catalogue and pricebooks the PWA then reads via SCAPI.
98	- **Omneo iFrame (My Account):** Omneo is also surfaced as a browser-direct iFrame in My Account (CRM-176), loaded with a customer-scoped session token issued server-side. All other Omneo traffic flows via MuleSoft.
99	- **PWA (MRT) → MuleSoft → NewStore:** read flows initiated directly by the PWA via MRT proxy — order history (CRM-056–057), order details (CRM-071–072), boutique stock check / Find in Boutique / Collect in Boutique (CFD-043). SFCC is not in this path. The channel authenticates via `client_id` + `client_secret`; `customer_id` is passed as a plain UUID query parameter.
100	- **SFCC server-side integrations (cartridge-based unless noted):** Avalara tax, Adyen server API (`/payments` and notifications) via cartridge; GiveX validate/redeem/refund via the **NewStore adapter** (SCAPI/SFCC → NewStore adapter → GiveX), and GiveX issuance at purchase via SCAPI/SFCC → MuleSoft → NewStore → GiveX.
101	- **Global-e (two surfaces):** (1) **browser handoff at checkout** — the PWA routes international shipping destinations to a Zimmermann checkout page that embeds the Global-e hosted checkout in an iframe from both mini-bag and cart, with an SFCC-prepared payload; the shopper stays on `zimmermann.com` (PAY-054). Global-e owns the entire checkout, addresses, payment, duties, tax, and order confirmation email. (2) **server-side feed into SFCC** — nightly FX rates / coefficients / rounding rules from Global-e generate Global-e-market pricebooks in SFCC (PRC-34..43); a daily SFCC → Global-e catalogue CSV is pushed via SFTP (PRC-54); GiveX validate/redeem/refund webhooks are exposed to Global-e (PRC-44).

Adyen Drop-In tokenises card data in the browser; the Adyen server API (`/payments`, notifications, refunds) runs in the SFCC cartridge. **Vimeo** hosts product video, embedded as a lazy iframe (facade-loaded to protect LCP); editorial-page video is Contentful by default but may also embed Vimeo (HPC-004).
- **PWA → Google Maps, GiveX balance check, MuleSoft (select direct calls), Booxi:** called from the PWA's MRT Node layer via `/mobify/proxy/` — API credentials held as MRT environment variables; never reach the browser bundle. GiveX balance check is not a direct GiveX call — GiveX is reachable only over a persistent TCP socket, so MRT proxies an HTTPS request to MuleSoft, which owns the GiveX connection and credentials. Boutique appointment history (CRM-165–167) is read by a PWA-direct call from the MRT Node layer straight to Booxi — SFCC and MuleSoft are not in this path. Booxi credentials held as MRT environment variables.
- **PWA → SFCC:** all commerce data (catalogue, cart, pricing, customer, orders) via `@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react`.
- **SFCC → MuleSoft → NewStore / AP21 / Omneo / Narvar:** write and sync flows (order creation, fulfilment, CRM sync, EDD) — initiated by SFCC.
- **AP21 → MuleSoft → SFCC (inbound):** product and pricing master feed populates the SFCC catalogue and pricebooks the PWA then reads via SCAPI.
- **Omneo iFrame (My Account):** Omneo is also surfaced as a browser-direct iFrame in My Account (CRM-176), loaded with a customer-scoped session token issued server-side. All other Omneo traffic flows via MuleSoft.
- **PWA (MRT) → MuleSoft → NewStore:** read flows initiated directly by the PWA via MRT proxy — order history (CRM-056–057), order details (CRM-071–072), boutique stock check / Find in Boutique / Collect in Boutique (CFD-043). SFCC is not in this path. The channel authenticates via `client_id` + `client_secret`; `customer_id` is passed as a plain UUID query parameter.
- **SFCC server-side integrations (cartridge-based unless noted):** Avalara tax, Adyen server API (`/payments` and notifications) via cartridge; GiveX validate/redeem/refund via the **NewStore adapter** (SCAPI/SFCC → NewStore adapter → GiveX), and GiveX issuance at purchase via SCAPI/SFCC → MuleSoft → NewStore → GiveX.
- **Global-e (two surfaces):** (1) **browser handoff at checkout** — the PWA routes international shipping destinations to a Zimmermann checkout page that embeds the Global-e hosted checkout in an iframe from both mini-bag and cart, with an SFCC-prepared payload; the shopper stays on `zimmermann.com` (PAY-054). Global-e owns the entire checkout, addresses, payment, duties, tax, and order confirmation email. (2) **server-side feed into SFCC** — nightly FX rates / coefficients / rounding rules from Global-e generate Global-e-market pricebooks in SFCC (PRC-34..43); a daily SFCC → Global-e catalogue CSV is pushed via SFTP (PRC-54); GiveX validate/redeem/refund webhooks are exposed to Global-e (PRC-44).
